target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures focus on developing new memory structures, materials, and packages for next-generation products. D062 explicitly states this focus alongside HBM development, while D069 confirms the focus on these structures/packages and highlights the HBM3E position.

D062 describes additional R&D efforts concentrated on advanced computing, storage, and mobile memory architectures. D070 contains identical wording regarding these specific additional R&D efforts.

Both disclosures list specific product design and development efforts. D062 includes DDR5, LPDDR5, HBM, CXL, 3D NAND, and SSDs. D071 lists HBM, DDR5, LPDDR5, CXL, NAND, and SSDs/managed NAND, covering the same technological scope.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD focuses its R&D on designing next-generation CPUs, GPUs, FPGAs, Adaptive SoCs, accelerators, SOMs, and SmartNICs, along with associated software and hardware design tools.

Both highlight the development of advanced semiconductor products and computing platforms as a core R&D priority.

comparisons.peer_topic: R&D investment scope and diversification targets
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm expects to continue investing in research and development to extend product demand and utilize R&D in industries beyond mobile handsets, such as automotive, IoT, ADAS/AD, and XR, while also focusing on enabling developers to deploy applications across multiple device categories.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and QCOM disclose significant R&D investment aimed at extending product demand and developing next-generation technologies across multiple industries. MU focuses on 'advanced computing, storage, and mobile memory architectures' and new opportunities leveraging semiconductor expertise. QCOM expects to continue investing in R&D to 'extend the demand for our products and technologies' and utilize that R&D in industries beyond mobile handsets, including automotive and IoT, while maintaining significant engineering resources in areas like advanced SoCs and AI. Both highlight a broad, forward-looking R&D strategy to sustain growth and technological relevance.

sentences.text: Additional R&D efforts are concentrated on the enablement of advanced computing, storage, and mobile memory architectures and the investigation of new opportunities that leverage our core semiconductor expertise.

We have significant engineering resources, including engineers with substantial expertise in modem, radio-frequency integrated circuit, RFFE, multimedia (camera, video, display and computer vision), sensor perception and drive policy, advanced SoC (which includes specialized engines such as CPU, GPU and NPU to enable high-performance and low-power computing and other optimization techniques), AI, packaging and a broad range of other technologies.

We expect to continue to invest in research and development in a variety of ways in an effort to extend the demand for our products and technologies and to utilize that research and development in industries and applications beyond mobile handsets (such as automotive and IoT), including continuing the development of new modem and multimedia technologies and other technologies (such as ADAS/AD and XR), developing alternative technologies for certain specialized applications, participating in the formulation of new voice and data communication standards and technologies and assisting in deploying digital voice and data communications networks around the world.
